Room 10 (cart lean-to) furnished in parts/room-10.mjs: a wheelwright's stock corner at the west end (barrels with a lantern, rim-stock logs), a fence-and-top-slab bench with a stair seat and a focal lantern, and a clear lane from the archway through to the open east side.
